text: An adjunction in a bicategory B between 1-cells f: A→B and u: B→A consists of:
choices: 2-cells η: 1_A ⇒ u∘f and ε: f∘u ⇒ 1_B satisfying triangle identities
A natural equivalence B(fA,-) ≅ A(A, u-)
explanation: An adjunction f ⊣ u in B is equivalently given by unit/counit 2-cells with triangle identities, or by a natural equivalence of hom-categories.
